title: ZERO-MINUTES-WORKER-1: Worker executor, diff gate and lane merge cost zero Actions minutes (live verification pending)
body:
**Owner:** infrastructure-manager
**Trigger:** each tick
**Done check:** file:seed/worker/src/pr-executor.js
**Status:** closed code merged, live proof pending the tick Worker token binding (OL-20261113-1)

seed/worker/src/pr-executor.js opens PRs from the Workers AI code agent through the GitHub REST API; worker-gate.js posts commit status worker-gate from the PR diff; lane.js merges on green worker-gate when ZERO_ACTIONS=1. Closing probe: with the token bound and ZERO_ACTIONS=1, `gh pr list --search 'head:agent/'` shows a Worker-opened PR (body says 'Worker executor') that merges while `python3 scripts/actions_budget.py` minutes for executor, checks and lane do not rise. Remaining: bind GITHUB_REPOS and ZERO_ACTIONS on the deployed tick Worker; move issues, retriage and scout sweeps to the Worker the same way (ZERO-MINUTES-2).

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 171.0 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
